en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered park bordered by multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. Bare trees laden with snow frame the view, while several figures in long coats walk or pull small sleds with children across the snowy ground. The photograph is printed with a white border, typical of early photographic postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
